Cristofori gave this instrument a name meaning 'harpsichord'... The Highland version of this instrument has a blowpipe, a chanter & 3 drones," the instrument being described is the **harpsichord** (or more formally, the **clavichord**, though the text specifies "harpsichord" as the name given by Cristofori). The instrument with the specific description of a blowpipe, chanter, and 3 drones in its Highland version is the **bagpipe**.

The question asks for the instrument of which the Highland version is described. The text identifies the Highland version of the **bagpipe** (specifically the Great Highland Bagpipe) as having these parts. The mention of Cristofori refers to the historical naming of the harpsichord, but the structural description following it clearly defines the bagpipe.

<answer>bagpipe</answer>
